source_work.it_title: Il Benessere è impossibile se non lo misuri
source_work.en_title: Wellbeing is impossible if you don't measure it

original_definitions.it: Quindi, il Benessere Numerico è la disciplina scientifica dove il miglioramento del Benessere individuale si ottiene attraverso l'uso di numeri, permettendo di monitorare e agire in modo pratico, immediato e misurabile.
original_definitions.en: So, Numerical Wellbeing is the scientific discipline where the improvement of individual Wellbeing is achieved through the use of numbers, allowing you to monitor and act in a practical, immediate and measurable way.

science_status_note: Authorial scientific discipline terminology; independent clinical or psychometric validation not established.

method_details.scale_example: 0-10 self-assessment; higher negative-emotion values can indicate greater distress
